verses.text: A psalm of praise. Of David. I will honour you, my God and King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
I will praise you every day. I will honour your name forever and ever.
The LORD is great and deserves great praise! No one can measure how great he is.
Parents will praise your works to their children. They will tell about your mighty acts.
I will think about your glorious majesty and your amazing works.
People will talk about the power of your awesome acts, and I will tell about your greatness.
They will celebrate your great goodness and sing joyfully about how you do what is right.
The LORD is kind and full of mercy. He is slow to get angry and full of faithful love.
The LORD is good to everyone. He shows mercy to everything he has made.
Everything you have made will thank you, LORD. Your faithful people will praise you.
They will talk about the glory of your kingdom and tell about your power,
so that everyone will know about your mighty acts and the glorious majesty of your kingdom.
Your kingdom lasts forever. You rule through all generations. The LORD keeps all his promises and is loving in everything he does.
The LORD holds up all who fall. He lifts up all who are bowed down.
Everyone looks to you with hope, and you give them their food at the right time.
You open your hand and satisfy the needs of every living thing.
The LORD is right in everything he does and kind in all his works.
The LORD is near to everyone who calls on him, to everyone who calls on him sincerely.
He gives those who respect him what they want. He hears their cry and saves them.
The LORD watches over everyone who loves him, but he will destroy all the wicked.
My mouth will praise the LORD. Let every living thing praise his holy name forever and ever.
